main_text.p: tur aër, tum forma à materia diffociatur. Sic de omnibus alijs corporibus, tum fimpli- cibus, tum miftis dum generantur, & cor- rumpuntur, iudicare licet. Quæ poftea fu- perioribus fubiungit, animaduerfione non parua fimiliter indiget. Subiectum (inquit) Cap.1.ex quo aliquid factum eft, ex materia & fpe cie conditum erat, fpecies perit, abitq; fuc- cedente altera, priuationemque tollente. Quòd fi hæc uera fint, confequetur idem fubiectum, ex quo fit hoc aliquid ad duas fimul contrarias formas, ad unam abeun- tem, & ad alteram fuccedentem referri, ac pertinere. Verum quàm fit hoc abfurdum fatis manifeftum apparet. Nam unius fub- iecti unam effe formam, & è conuerfo uni- us formæ unicam fufficere materiam, hafte nus præclariores philofophi funt profefsi. Cùm præterea fubdit, fpecies perit, abitq; fuccedere altera, cum impofsibile profert. Etenim forma à fuo fubiecto abire simul & perire nequit. Quòd enim perit, qui, & quò tandem abibit? Sed ad cæ- tera progredi licet.

page.notes: Marginal "Cap.1." is a running reference in the left margin. Uncertain readings: "fubdit" (likely "subdit" with long s rendered as f in print; retained as printed), "hafte" (likely "haec" or "hac te" in print; retained as printed). The "»" marks are margin line-markers (ditto or continuation marks) and are not transcribed as text. The catchword "EX-" at the foot right is a catchword and is placed as such in the bottom margin; a stray "*" mark appears beside "perioribus" and is not text.
